meta.description: Curated showcase of student sustainability outcomes. This gallery collects NO personal data. Items are added only by staff, editing this file and placing an image in the /gallery-images/ folder. Show the WORK, not the child. Label by year group and SDG only, never by name.
meta.privacyNote: Work is shared with school permission. No personal data is collected on this site.
meta.howToAddAnItem: 1) Save the image into /gallery-images/  2) Add a new object below with its title, yearGroup, sdg, image path, and caption  3) Save the file — the website updates automatically.

gallery.title: Recycled Materials Sculpture
gallery.caption: A sculpture built entirely from classroom waste, exploring how rubbish can become something new.

gallery.title: Save Our Seas Poster
gallery.caption: A pupil-designed awareness poster asking families to cut down on single-use plastic.

gallery.title: School Vegetable Harvest
gallery.caption: The first harvest from our school garden, grown and cared for by the class.

gallery.title: Solar Model Prototype

gallery.title: Water Filtration Design
gallery.caption: A student-engineered filter, refined over several iterations to clean cloudy water.

gallery.title: Upcycled Product Prototype
gallery.caption: A discarded object redesigned into something genuinely useful, with the design thinking on display.

gallery.title: Greener School Proposal

gallery.title: Fast Fashion Campaign Board
gallery.caption: A campaign exploring the true lifecycle cost of a single garment.

gallery.caption: Student-collected data visualised to argue for practical changes at home and school.

gallery.title: Renewable Energy Rig

gallery.caption: A student enterprise product designed around sustainable materials and fair value.
